units: Unreal: cm, s (clip time), deg, m/s; x forward, y right, z up, yaw deg (+ toward +y). Blender (x, y, z) m = (100 x, -100 y, 100 z) cm at rig scale, then x game_scale.
actor_frame: x forward along the dragon's nose, y right, z up; origin = rig origin on the floor at frame 0, moved by the track. The C++ adds its own mesh-in-actor offset and yaw.
